action_legality_checks.policy_evidence: For a delivered order, each item can be exchanged to an available new item of the same product but of different product option. There cannot be any change of product types, e.g. modify shirt to shoe.
action_legality_checks.conversation_evidence: User requested to exchange item ID 2757705742 (wireless earbud, IPX7) for item ID 1646531091 (wireless earbud, IPX4), but both items are already part of the same order.
action_legality_checks.reasoning: The exchange action attempted to exchange an item in the order for another item that is already present in the same order. Policy only allows exchanging an item for a new available item of the same product but with different options, not for another item already in the order. This is a same-item exchange, which is not supported.
action_legality_checks.correct_action: Inform the user that exchanging for another item already in the same order is not permitted, and request a different available variant not already in the order.
